## Corpus daily-syllabus-as-conversation (2026-06-08 session 6, srs-mccqe1 parity)

User: 'tutor must handle the daily syllabus as a conversation like c:/dev/srs-mccqe1'. srs-mccqe1's pattern (src/session/index.js + daily/planner.js): present today's plan, walk it item-by-item as dialogue, student responds, coach scores/advances, end-of-day summary.

IMPLEMENTED + browser-witnessed with model loaded:
- tutor.js SYS.daily: interactive daily coach - presents today's plan ONE block at a time, ALWAYS ends inviting a reply, drives page via tool blocks (start_session/open_guide/navigate), 2-4 sentences.
- tutor.js buildDailyPlanLine(plan): schedule blocks -> terse ordered '- subject: N reviews, N new, N guide sections, N cases' (zeros skipped, [done] for completed b.done); caught-up fallback when no actionable blocks.
- tutor.js cmd 'daily-syllabus': builds planLine+ctxLine user turn, SEEDS worker history (pushHistory user+assistant) so the KV-fixed chat path continues the walk coherently, runChat SYS.daily doneEvent=daily-syllabus-done.
- tutor-panel.js: daily-syllabus-done added to the PERSIST group (coaching-done/guide-answer-done) - persists as thread turn + consumes the daily check-in slot (shouldCheckInToday/markCheckedIn). export startDailySyllabus(plan) + setDailyPlanProvider(fn). 'Walk me through today' is the lead starter chip (special-cased to call startDailySyllabus with the provider's plan).
- app.js: daily check-in posts startDailySyllabus(plan) with today's schedule.loadSchedule() blocks filtered by date (was one-shot session-overview). setDailyPlanProvider registered in init.

WITNESS (model ready, browser session 6): opener -> 'Hello! It's 13:00... caught up on reviews... weakest is cardiology... 7 days until exam... start with a light review of cardiology basics. Ready to start cardiology? Say go, or tell me what you'd rather do first.' Reply 'go' -> emitted \`\`\`tool start_session{cardiology}\`\`\`. Full interactive walk works: opener presents plan + invites reply; reply advances + drives page. Zero-due day pivoted to weak-area drilling (caught-up corner handled).

GOTCHA: worker LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS=180s - if the daily-syllabus cmd is posted while the model is mid-download (>3min), it errors 'model load timed out' 3x. Re-trigger after pill shows ready:ready. test.js: 6 daily assertions added (SYS.daily, handler, buildDailyPlanLine, daily-syllabus-done persists, opener invites, startDailySyllabus+provider, Walk-chip, app launches with blocks), 19 pass. Deferred vs srs-mccqe1: no per-answer 0-5 AI scoring inside the walk (corpus uses SM-2 review UI + autoCoachOnReview), no explicit auto end-of-day summary turn (reachable via chat).
